source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the date and time of the inspection.
3. Note the name of the building and its address.
4. Detail who conducted the inspection, including their name and qualifications.
5. Refer to the accepted fire-safety protocols or regulations being checked against.
6. List each failed item, detail the specific regulation it violates, and include a description of the deficiency.
7. For each failed item, provide photographic evidence if possible.
8. Record any immediate hazards and the exact nature of the risk posed.
9. Note the status of previous warnings or notices for the same issue.
10. Document whether the responsible parties were informed of the failings and their response.
11. Include any recommendations for correction.
12. If necessary, cite the need for immediate corrective action and/or evacuation.
13. Propose a timeline for re-inspection, if one is required.
14. Record any follow-up actions arranged or promised by responsible parties.
